description: This file implements a login page component for a web application using React. It manages a two-step login flow: first collecting the user's email to fetch associated organizations, then allowing the user to select an organization or input one manually, and finally submitting login credentials. It handles UI states, form submissions, navigation, and interactions with external APIs and context.

methods.name: handleFetchOrgs
methods.description: Handles the form submission to fetch user organizations based on email input, updates state accordingly.

methods.name: handleLogin
methods.description: Handles the login form submission, performs validation, calls login API, manages navigation upon success or failure.
